items.ti: RT @SchoenlawBy engaging in an unprecedented tripartite summit with the leaders of China and Russia, countries with which we have profound differences, President Trump not only continues his well-founded policy of always seeking to keep dialogue open, but that policy is consistent with the great statesmen of generations past:Abraham Lincoln: “Do I not destroy my enemies when I make them my friends?" Yitzhak Rabin: “You don't make peace with friends. You make it with very unsavory enemies." Winston Churchill: “It is better to jaw-jaw than to war-war”Lord Palmerston: “We have no eternal allies, and we have no perpetual enemies. Our interests are eternal and perpetual, and those interests it is our duty to follow."John F. Kennedy: “Let us never negotiate out of fear. But let us never fear to negotiate." @realDonaldTrump
